verdict: Shopify grew revenue 34% to $3.17B and merchants cleared $100B of sales in a quarter for the first time — but a $1,064M paper loss on its equity investments turned a $382M operating profit into a $581M GAAP net loss.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: diluted, after the investment paper loss

kpis.label: GMV
kpis.note: merchant sales through the platform, +35% YoY

segments.name: Subscription solutions
segments.note: Monthly fees merchants pay to use the platform. Up 21% YoY; monthly recurring revenue was $212M at quarter end.

segments.name: Merchant solutions
segments.note: Payments, shipping and other services that scale with merchant sales. Up 39% YoY as gross merchandise volume rose 35% to $100,743M.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Selling the platform and winning new merchants. Up 22% YoY.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building the platform and new commerce and AI features. Up 16% YoY.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: The back office — finance, legal and admin. Up 6% YoY.

opex.name: Transaction and loan losses
opex.note: Losses on merchant loans and cash advances, and transaction losses. Up 55% YoY.

follow100Note: The swing factor sits below the operating line: paper losses on Shopify's stakes in other companies took $31.39 of every $100 of revenue.
otherDetail: Other expense of $1,016M net (including the separate equity-method line) was dominated by a $1,064M unrealized — paper — loss on equity and other investments, partly offset by $75M of interest income, a $3M realized gain and a $9M foreign-exchange loss; the equity-method investment lost a further $21M. Tax was a $53M recovery (benefit).
footerNote: Excluding the paper loss on equity investments, Shopify's own measure of net income was $360M. The GAAP net loss was $581M.

takeaways.title: Growth accelerated, GMV passed $100B
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 34% to $3,170M as gross merchandise volume — everything merchants sold through Shopify — grew 35% to $100,743M, the first $100B quarter. Merchant solutions revenue rose 39% to $2,420M.

takeaways.title: A paper loss created the headline loss
takeaways.text: Shopify's stakes in other companies fell in value by $1,064M on paper in the quarter. That non-cash mark-to-market loss sits below operating income, which was actually up 88% to $382M; excluding equity-investment effects, net income was $360M.

takeaways.title: Cash flow stayed at a 15% margin
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $476M, 15% of revenue — the same margin as a year ago — while monthly recurring revenue reached $212M. For Q2, Shopify guided revenue growth in the high twenties percent.

oneTimers: Unrealized loss on equity and other investments: $1,064M — a non-cash mark-to-market loss on Shopify's stakes in other companies; Shopify excludes equity-investment effects from its own adjusted net income measure ($360M this quarter).
